subtitle: How a wandering Drukpa yogi made Hemis a power behind the throne

panels.shot: sweeping low-angle wide of a cliff-top monastery above a stark Ladakhi valley
panels.action: Stag-tshang-ras-pa stands on a rocky outcrop above Hemis monastery, prayer beads in hand and cloak whipping in the Ladakhi wind, as the whitewashed fortress-like buildings cling to the cliff beneath a vast Himalayan sky.

dialogue.text: In Sengge Namgyal’s Ladakh, a barefoot Drukpa yogi named Stag-tshang-ras-pa helped raise Hemis from a lonely cliff to a monastery-state that could guide kings.

i18n.hi: सेंगे नामग्याल के लद्दाख में, नंगे पाँव द्रुक्पा योगी स्तग-छंग-रस्पा ने अकेली चट्टान पर बसे हेमिस को ऐसा मठ-राज्य बनाया जो राजाओं को दिशा दे सके।

panels.shot: medium wide of a dusty mountain path winding between high passes
panels.action: A younger Stag-tshang-ras-pa, travel-worn yet serene, walks alone along a narrow trail above a deep gorge, a simple bundle on his back, distant snow peaks shimmering beyond.

dialogue.text: Before Hemis, he was only a wanderer: a Drukpa monk, raised in the high plateaus of Tibet, walking from hermitage to hermitage with nothing but robes, texts and a fierce hunger for practice.

i18n.hi: हेमिस से पहले वह बस एक भटकता साधु था—तिब्बत के ऊँचे पठारों में पला द्रुक्पा भिक्षु, बस चोगा, ग्रंथ और साधना की तेज भूख लेकर एकांत से एकांत तक चलता।

panels.shot: intimate interior medium close-up inside a modest Himalayan assembly hall
panels.action: Stag-tshang-ras-pa sits cross-legged before a small gathering of monks and layfolk in a smoky stone hall, his eyes intense as he recites, butter lamps flickering between worn manuscripts.

dialogue.text: His own rnam thar, his sacred life story, calls him a siddha, a realised Drukpa adept. It tells of visions and wonders, but behind the poetry lies a working teacher, preaching and debating in remote halls.

i18n.hi: अपने ही र्नाम थर, पवित्र जीवन कथा, में वह सिद्ध कहा गया है—सिद्ध द्रुक्पा साधक। उसमें दर्शनों और चमत्कारों की बात है, पर कविता के पीछे उभरा है एक कार्यशील गुरु, जो दूरदराज़ सभागारों में उपदेश देता और शास्त्रार्थ करता है।

panels.shot: wide shot of a caravan crossing a high pass into a broad valley
panels.action: Stag-tshang-ras-pa rides a hardy pony beside a line of traders and monks easing down a snow-dusted pass, prayer flags snapping in the wind as the Indus valley opens below.

dialogue.text: In the late sixteenth century, his road bent west. Trade routes, pilgrim paths and invitations from Drukpa circles drew him from Central Tibet into Ladakh, the Indus kingdom between Kashmir and Ngari.

i18n.hi: सोलहवीं सदी के उत्तरार्ध में उसका रास्ता पश्चिम मुड़ गया। व्यापार-मार्ग, तीर्थ-पथ और द्रुक्पा मंडलियों के निमंत्रण उसे मध्य तिब्बत से खींचकर लाए लद्दाख, कश्मीर और ङारी के बीच के सिंधु-राज्य में।

panels.shot: bird’s-eye view of Leh and its palace rising above the town
panels.action: The multi-tiered Leh palace looms over clustered mud-brick houses and the winding bazaar, with barren ridges and high peaks framing the small yet strategic mountain capital.

dialogue.text: Ladakh then was ruled by the Namgyal dynasty, a line that had fought its way out from older petty chiefs, balancing Tibet, Kashmir and Mughal powers while building a new capital at Leh.

i18n.hi: तब लद्दाख पर नमग्याल वंश का राज था—एक ऐसी कड़ी जिसने पुराने छोटे मुखियाओं से लड़कर उभरना सीखा, तिब्बत, कश्मीर और मुग़ल ताकतों के बीच संतुलन रखते हुए लेह में नई राजधानी बसाई।

panels.shot: medium wide of an early, modest Hemis site nestled in a side valley
panels.action: A small cluster of whitewashed buildings hugs a cliff in a side valley off the Indus, a few monks moving between them, juniper smoke curling up against the rock.

dialogue.text: Hemis itself existed before him, a Drukpa seat linked to earlier teachers. But it was still one monastery among many, modest in buildings and reach, overshadowed by older centres in the region.

i18n.hi: हेमिस तब भी था—एक द्रुक्पा आसन, पहले के गुरुओं से जुड़ा। पर वह अब भी कई मठों में बस एक था, इमारतों और पहुँच में साधारण, इलाके के पुराने केन्द्रों की छाया में।

panels.shot: medium shot in a temple courtyard where monks and villagers listen
panels.action: In the courtyard of an early Hemis, Stag-tshang-ras-pa stands before assembled monks and villagers, gesturing gently with his mala as a cold wind flutters the hems of their robes.

dialogue.text: When Stag-tshang-ras-pa arrived, he brought more than sermons. He carried lineages, commentaries and the authority of the wider Drukpa world that stretched across Tibet and the Himalaya.

i18n.hi: जब स्तग-छंग-रस्पा पहुँचा, तो वह सिर्फ उपदेश नहीं लाया। वह वंशावलियाँ, भाष्य और उस व्यापक द्रुक्पा जगत का अधिकार लेकर आया जो तिब्बत से हिमालय तक फैला था।

panels.shot: dim interior close-up of hands turning brittle pages by lamplight
panels.action: His weathered hands carefully turn the pages of a Tibetan manuscript beside a flickering butter lamp, marginal notes visible as he compares two texts in quiet concentration.

dialogue.text: His autobiography hints at the work behind the legend: copying texts by hand, teaching ritual, standardising liturgy, binding Ladakh’s Drukpa houses into one disciplined, literate network.

i18n.hi: उसकी आत्मकथा दंतकथा के पीछे की घिसाई दिखाती है—अपने हाथ से ग्रंथ नकल करना, विधि सिखाना, पूजा-पद्धति को एकरूप बनाना, और लद्दाख के द्रुक्पा घरों को एक अनुशासित, साक्षर जाल में कसना।

panels.shot: low-angle interior wide of Sengge Namgyal’s throne room in Leh palace
panels.action: Inside a richly painted hall, Sengge Namgyal sits erect on a low throne, nobles and officials arrayed to either side, the thick walls hung with thangkas and yak-hair banners.

dialogue.text: Around 1616, Sengge Namgyal took power. Strong-willed and ambitious, he expanded Ladakh’s borders, built palaces and monasteries, and sought religious allies who could bless and legitimise his rule.

i18n.hi: करीब १६१६ में सेंगे नामग्याल सत्ता में आए। दृढ़ और महत्वाकांक्षी, उन्होंने लद्दाख की सीमाएँ बढ़ाईं, किले और मठ बनवाए, और ऐसे धार्मिक साथी खोजे जो उनके राज को आशीष और वैधता दे सकें।

panels.shot: medium shot of Stag-tshang-ras-pa entering the palace audience hall
panels.action: Stag-tshang-ras-pa, simple robes dusted from travel, steps into the Leh audience hall, pausing at the threshold as courtiers turn to look, the king’s eyes narrowing with interest.

dialogue.text: Francke’s accounts and monastery traditions agree: the king and the yogi met. A wandering Drukpa master entered the Namgyal court and became, over time, its quiet spiritual architect.

i18n.hi: फ़्रान्के के लेख और मठ की परंपराएँ एक बात पर सहमत हैं—राजा और योगी मिले। एक घुमंतू द्रुक्पा आचार्य नमग्याल दरबार में पहुँचा और धीरे-धीरे उसका शांत आध्यात्मिक वास्तुकार बन गया।

panels.shot: tight two-shot profile of Sengge Namgyal and Stag-tshang-ras-pa in conversation
panels.action: Sengge Namgyal leans forward on his throne, listening intently, as Stag-tshang-ras-pa speaks calmly, gaze steady, a faint smile on his lips against a backdrop of painted deities.

dialogue.speaker: stag_tshang_ras_pa
dialogue.text: O king, a realm stands firm when its law and its Dharma stand together.

i18n.hi: राजन, राज्य तब टिकता है जब उसकी राज-व्यवस्था और धर्म एक साथ खड़े हों।

panels.shot: wide shot of Hemis valley with masons and workers around expanding monastery
panels.action: In the rugged Hemis valley, scaffolding clings to rock as workers haul stones and timber, new temple walls rising beside older structures beneath a hard, bright sky.

dialogue.text: Under Sengge’s patronage and Stag-tshang-ras-pa’s guidance, Hemis expanded. Francke records that the king endowed the monastery, binding royal wealth to Drukpa ritual and scholarship.

i18n.hi: सेंगे की सरपरस्ती और स्तग-छंग-रस्पा की राहनुमाई में हेमिस बढ़ा। फ़्रान्के लिखता है कि राजा ने मठ को दान दिए, राजकोष को द्रुक्पा विधि-विधान और विद्वत्ता से बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: medium wide of scribes and novices inside a Hemis library chamber
panels.action: Inside a cool, dark library, monks sit in rows copying texts onto long folios, shelves behind them stacked with wrapped manuscripts, a senior monk overseeing their work.

dialogue.text: Hemis did more than chant. Its monks copied scriptures, taught aristocratic sons, trained administrators and scribes. In a kingdom of few schools, monastic classrooms shaped the future officials of Ladakh.

i18n.hi: हेमिस सिर्फ जप नहीं करता था। उसके भिक्षु शास्त्र नकल करते, कुलीन पुत्रों को पढ़ाते, अफसर और लेखपाल तैयार करते। कुछ स्कूलों वाले राज्य में, इन्हीं मठ-विद्यालयों ने भविष्य के लद्दाखी अधिकारियों को गढ़ा।

panels.shot: medium shot of Stag-tshang-ras-pa mediating between two laymen in a courtyard
panels.action: Two Ladakhi villagers, faces tense, stand before Stag-tshang-ras-pa in a monastery courtyard, their hands folded as he listens, other monks looking on.

dialogue.text: The rnam thar and later records show monks judging disputes and enforcing discipline. When villagers quarrelled or estates clashed, Hemis’ abbots could speak with a weight close to royal law.

i18n.hi: र्नाम थर और बाद के दस्तावेज़ दिखाते हैं कि भिक्षु झगड़े निपटाते और अनुशासन लागू करते थे। जब गाँव भिड़ते या जायदादें टकरातीं, तो हेमिस के आचार्य लगभग राज-आदेश जैसी हैसियत से बोलते।

panels.shot: high-angle wide of terraced fields below Hemis with villagers working
panels.action: Below the monastery, green terraced fields step down the valley, peasants bent over the crops while a monk walks the boundary ridge, the monastery buildings looming above.

dialogue.text: Endowments gave Hemis land and villages. Farmers tilled fields whose surplus climbed to the cliff-top. In return, monks offered rituals, festivals and protection of rights, weaving economy into faith.

i18n.hi: दानों ने हेमिस को ज़मीन और गाँव दिए। किसान उन खेतों को जोतते जिनकी बचत चट्टान-शिखर तक चढ़ती। बदले में भिक्षु विधि-विधान, त्योहार और अधिकारों की रक्षा देते, और अर्थव्यवस्था को आस्था में पिरोते।

panels.shot: medium interior of Sengge Namgyal performing a ritual with Hemis monks
panels.action: Sengge Namgyal kneels in full royal attire before a Hemis altar, offering a golden bowl as senior monks in Drukpa hats chant behind him, incense thick in the air.

dialogue.text: Royal inscriptions remember Sengge’s gifts to Hemis, but those gifts flowed back as ritual merit. Coronations, campaigns and building projects were sealed with Drukpa ceremonies that stitched king and monastery together.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख सेंगे की भेंटों को याद रखते हैं, पर वे भेंटें पुण्य बनकर लौटती रहीं। राजतिलक, सेनाएँ और निर्माण—सब द्रुक्पा अनुष्ठानों से मुहरबंद हुए, जिन्होंने राजा और मठ को एक-साथ सिल दिया।

panels.shot: art-historical style medium shot of a thangka depicting an ascetic yogi
panels.action: A richly painted thangka hangs in a dark chamber, showing an ascetic Drukpa yogi with loose hair and simple robes, seated on a rocky seat amidst swirling clouds and mountains.

dialogue.text: Later thangkas, studied by art historians like Rob Linrothe, keep his image alive: a yogi-saint, wild yet composed, embodying the Drukpa ideal of discipline and inner fire perched above worldly courts.

i18n.hi: बाद की थाङ्का चित्रों में, जिनका अध्ययन रॉब लीन्रोथ जैसे कला-इतिहासकारों ने किया, उसका रूप जिंदा है—एक योगी-साधु, उग्र पर संयत, द्रुक्पा की अनुशासन और भीतरी ज्वाला की छवि, जो सांसारिक दरबारों के ऊपर विराजती है।

panels.shot: twilight medium shot of an older Stag-tshang-ras-pa overlooking Hemis from a ridge
panels.action: In the fading light, an older Stag-tshang-ras-pa stands on a ridge above Hemis, staff in hand, watching lamps flicker on in the monastery and the dark valley below.

dialogue.text: His own rnam thar wraps his last years in miracle and symbol. The archives, quieter, simply show what remained: a strengthened Hemis, a Drukpa network, and royal charters that bore his traces.

i18n.hi: उसका अपना र्नाम थर उसकी अंतिम वर्षों को चमत्कार और प्रतीक में समेट देता है। पर शांत अभिलेख बताते हैं कि क्या बचा—मज़बूत हेमिस, फैला द्रुक्पा जाल, और राज-फ़रमान जिन पर उसकी छाप थी।

panels.shot: dawn wide of Hemis monastery dominating the valley, tiny figures moving below
panels.action: At dawn, Hemis monastery crowns the cliff like a small white fortress, prayer flags streaming as tiny monks and villagers move below, the vast Himalayan ridges stretching into pale light.

dialogue.text: Stag-tshang-ras-pa never wore a crown, yet through texts, land grants and counsel he helped remake Ladakh’s balance of power, leaving Hemis as a monastery-state that still reminds us how faith can quietly frame a kingdom.

i18n.hi: स्तग-छंग-रस्पा ने कभी मुकुट नहीं पहना, पर ग्रंथों, भूमि-दानों और सलाह के ज़रिए उसने लद्दाख की ताकत का संतुलन बदलने में मदद की, और हेमिस को ऐसा मठ-राज्य छोड़ा जो आज भी याद दिलाता है कि आस्था कैसे चुपचाप एक राज्य की रूपरेखा गढ़ सकती है।

subtitle_i18n.en: How a wandering Drukpa yogi made Hemis a power behind the throne
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे एक घुमंतू द्रुक्पा योगी ने हेमिस को सिंहासन के पीछे की ताकत बनाया
